announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v3.0.4
announcement.content:
v3.0.4 Update

  • Added Keep characters on their side to the Versus setup's Screen tab. Character images are clipped at the boundary between the sides, with the theme's dividing line drawn over them.
  • Fixed doorway shadows covering other characters in Fantasy Versus screens with multiple characters on a side.
  • Fixed the default Teko font not loading and Tarot and Paper Theater using Teko instead of their own theme font.
  • Removed trigger lists and Add Trigger buttons that did not work in the Scene Editor. Combat start, round start, and combat end automation remain available.
  • Fixed bundled sound effects failing to play on The Forge. The sound picker finds the host's uploaded module sounds, and older presets with missing default sounds use bundled replacements.
